Homogeneity criterion of anchor pixels

Source: R/metric-anchors.R
ef_homogeneity.Rd

Defines the spatial homogeneity test applied to anchor pixel candidates: the dispersion of a variable (usually the surface temperature) in a square moving window centred on the candidate must not exceed a maximum. Used in ef_anchor_criteria() and, to audit user-supplied anchors, in ef_anchors().

Usage

ef_homogeneity(variable, window, stat, max, window_na)

Arguments

variable

Character. Layer whose dispersion is evaluated: "lst", "ndvi", "albedo" or "lai".

window

Integer. Side of the square window in cells: odd and >= 3.

stat

Character. Dispersion statistic; only "sd" (sample standard deviation, denominator n - 1) is available.

max

Numeric. Maximum dispersion for a homogeneous candidate, in the unit of variable (K for "lst"). Finite and >= 0.

window_na

Character. Treatment of windows with missing values or that cross the grid border: "exclude" (the candidate is not homogeneous unless the window is complete) or "available" (the statistic uses the available cells, at least two; this is the treatment observed in the water package).

Value

A list of class earthflux_homogeneity with the arguments as elements.

Details

The window is defined in cells; its size in metres depends on the cell size of the grid, which ef_select_anchors() records (with MODIS 1 km cells a 5 x 5 window covers 5 km x 5 km, against 150 m x 150 m for Landsat; dev/specs/anchor-pixels.md section 4, Q-AP-03). Anchors whose window is incomplete are flagged with EF_ANCHOR_WINDOW_INCOMPLETE. Errors are of class earthflux_input_error (and subclasses).

Verification status: the window of 5 x 5 cells and the maximum of 1.5 K observed in water are CANDIDATA; no value is a default here.

See also

Other anchor pixel functions: ef_anchor_conditions(), ef_anchor_criteria(), ef_anchor_pick(), ef_anchor_rule(), ef_anchors(), ef_select_anchors()

Examples

ef_homogeneity("lst", window = 3, stat = "sd", max = 0.5,
               window_na = "exclude")
#> $variable
#> [1] "lst"
#> 
#> $window
#> [1] 3
#> 
#> $stat
#> [1] "sd"
#> 
#> $max
#> [1] 0.5
#> 
#> $window_na
#> [1] "exclude"
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "earthflux_homogeneity" "list"
